corrections.source_says: The study runs LDA on the titles, abstracts, and keywords of publications. Nobody is assigned to anything, so "individual" states an assignment level that the paper does not have. Use "other", the closest allowed value.
corrections.quote: Latent Dirichlet Allocation applied to titles, abstracts, and keywords identifies 20 topics consolidated into five thematic clusters

confirmed: Design class synthesis and context class synthesis are correct: the paper is a topic-modelling systematic mapping review of 61 publications with no participants (Abstract).
No study in the paper assigns people to generative AI. The only method the abstract names is LDA on titles, abstracts, and keywords (Abstract).
Counts: 61 counts publications and is recorded as k_studies. People counts are null and counts_are is other, which fits a review with no participants (Abstract).
participants.quote is verbatim and 12 words long (Abstract).

20 topics in five thematic clusters, the five cluster names, the four GenAI roles (ideation, co-creation, personalisation, guidance/feedback), and the outcomes fluency, originality, diversity/voice, and agency/integrity all match (Abstract).
The abstract reports no pooled estimate, interval, or effect-size count, so pooled [] and n_effect_sizes null match the source read (Abstract).
one_line_finding matches the abstract and names it as the source (Abstract).

source.version is exact: the abstract text is identical in Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar. Crossref gives vol. 30, issue 03n04, article number 2650021, print date May 2026, online date 18 June 2026 (Crossref record).

No full text is open: OpenAlex lists one location with oa_status closed and no repository full text, and Semantic Scholar marks the paper not open access. The publisher page returned HTTP 403 and I did not pursue it (OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar records).

No other version found: a Crossref title search finds no other version of this paper, the Crossref relation field is empty, an arXiv title search returns nothing, and Europe PMC has no record of the DOI (searches of 5 October 2026).
The title and the six authors match the Crossref record, which prints the title in capitals (Crossref record).

company_involvement any false fits the metadata: all six authors list university affiliations (KFUPM, Sungkyunkwan University), and the one funder is the KFUPM Deanship of Research, award CUP2602 (Crossref record).
population mixed fits the abstract, which places the research across education, creative industries, and organisational innovation (Abstract).
Eligibility core no with all three criteria not_met is correct, and randomized not_stated is acceptable for a review with no participants (Abstract).
notes says correctly that the full text was not read and that quantitative summaries in it could not be checked.
summary: c028 is a closed-access topic-modelling mapping review of 61 publications with no participants and no randomized study, and the form's classes, counts, quote, and finding match the abstract, the only source reachable. Two small fixes: search_end should say that the abstract gives only the publications' date range (2023 to June 2025) and no search date, and assignment.unit should be "other" because nothing is assigned.
